items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: during this time when I got a call from Dakota Staton. And I went to New York, rehearsed with her

ctx.x: during this time when I got a call from Dakota Staton. And I went to New York, rehearsed with her, and then we... I think we worked maybe a club or so, but the big thing that I remember about her (I think it was 1960) was the Newport Jazz Festival. It was the year they had a big riot up there. Well, it wasn't a riot, but people just went crazy, because so many people that came to the Festival that really didn't care anything about Jazz, but the idea of people coming together was something like the thing they had…
